mapper.select: SELECT /* 오늘 전체 예정 */ SUM(CASE WHEN f.next_scheduled_at >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND f.next_scheduled_at < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS todayTotal, /* 오늘 완료 */ SUM(CASE WHEN f.next_scheduled_at >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND f.next_scheduled_at < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM inspections i WHERE i.facility_id = f.facility_id AND TRUNC(i.submitted_at) = TRUNC(f.next_scheduled_at) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS todayCompleted FROM facilities f WHERE f.managers_id = #{managerId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM citizen_reports cr JOIN facilities f ON f.facility_id = cr.facility_id WHERE cr.status = 'PENDING' AND f.managers_id = #{managerId}

WITH days AS ( SELECT TRUNC(SYSDATE) - LEVEL AS day_val FROM dual CONNECT BY LEVEL <= #{days} ), s AS ( -- 예정 SELECT TRUNC(f.next_scheduled_at) AS day_val, f.facility_id FROM facilities f WHERE TRUNC(f.next_scheduled_at) BETWEEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) - #{days} AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 1 AND f.managers_id = #{managerId} ), c AS ( -- 완료 SELECT TRUNC(i.submitted_at) AS day_val, i.facility_id FROM inspections i JOIN facilities f ON f.facility_id = i.facility_id WHERE TRUNC(i.submitted_at) BETWEEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) - #{days} AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 1 AND f.managers_id = #{managerId} ), sc AS (SELECT day_val, COUNT(*) AS scheduled_cnt FROM s GROUP BY day_val), cc AS (SELECT day_val, COUNT(*) AS completed_cnt FROM c GROUP BY day_val) SELECT d.day_val AS dayValue, CASE WHEN NVL(sc.scheduled_cnt,0) + NVL(cc.completed_cnt,0) = 0 THEN 100 ELSE TRUNC( (NVL(cc.completed_cnt,0) * 100.0) / (NVL(sc.scheduled_cnt,0) + NVL(cc.completed_cnt,0)) ) END AS percent FROM days d LEFT JOIN sc ON sc.day_val = d.day_val LEFT JOIN cc ON cc.day_val = d.day_val ORDER BY d.day_val
